note: Applies the technology, organization and environment framework to GenAI adoption across 108 organisations.
title: Towards Adoption of Generative AI in Organizational Settings
explain_beginner: This study examined what influences companies to adopt generative AI tools like ChatGPT. Researchers surveyed 108 organizations in India to identify the key factors that help or hinder adoption. They found that success depends on technology capabilities, organizational readiness, and environmental conditions. Understanding these factors matters because generative AI can deliver significant business benefits, but only if organizations are prepared to implement it thoughtfully across their operations.
explain_business: This research identifies the critical success factors for deploying generative AI in organizations. Executives considering AI adoption should assess their organization against three dimensions: technology readiness, internal capabilities and culture, and external market conditions. The study of 108 companies provides empirical evidence about what works, helping leadership teams make informed investment decisions and prioritize necessary organizational changes before implementation, reducing adoption risk and maximizing return on generative AI investments.
explain_practitioner: The researchers applied the Technology-Organization-Environment framework combined with institutional and diffusion of innovation theories to analyze generative AI adoption patterns. They collected and analyzed data from 108 Indian organizations to identify determinants of implementation success. The study reveals which technological, organizational, and environmental factors most significantly influence whether companies successfully adopt and integrate generative AI tools. These findings provide a structured understanding of adoption barriers and enablers for practitioners planning integration strategies.
